info.aldi:
ALDI Ireland case study (60%). You're a junior marketer on Aldi Ireland's team. Use the module's marketing principles to analyse the situation and explain how the brand could respond.

  • Submit on Moodle by Tue 1 Dec, 6pm ("SUBMIT HERE- ALDI"). Email submissions aren't accepted. It goes through Turnitin.
  • 1,500 words, excluding the cover page, appendix, bibliography and declaration sheet.
  • Times New Roman, 12pt, 1.5 spacing. Harvard referencing throughout.
  • Cover page with your name, K number, course and module. The declaration sheet (on Moodle under CA) must be the final page.

Questions:

  • Segmentation, targeting and positioning (40 marks): four ways to segment the Irish grocery market, each with an example customer group · pick one segment and give two reasons Aldi might target it · describe Aldi's positioning and the customer value it communicates · one way Lidl's positioning differs from Aldi's (not just price).
  • The marketing mix (40 marks): two product decisions supporting the target market · why price matters so much to Aldi, and the risks of relying heavily on it · and the remaining Place and Promotion parts (see the brief).
  • Environment: the micro-environment (customers, competitors, suppliers, employees) and macro-environment (PEST) are covered in the case. Check the brief for how the remaining marks are split.

Relevant lectures on Moodle: Marketing Environment, STP, and Evolution of Marketing Mix.
